name: Bi'an
description: Bi'an is a bilingual benchmark and model framework for hallucination detection in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It includes a bilingual benchmark dataset and lightweight judge models fine-tuned from compact open-source LLMs to rigorously evaluate hallucination detection across multiple RAG scenarios.
reputation: A very recent arXiv benchmark with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on hallucination detection in RAG; includes bilingual data and lightweight judge models; data and models to be released.
